scripts/review/record.py:scripts.review..reason: _head first calls number_of on the requested URL. Every supported request URL has a numeric final path component, optionally followed by slash characters, so its right edge contains digits or slashes and never X. Stripping the character set X plus slash removes exactly the same suffix as stripping slash alone. Thus the target match check, refusal and returned head remain identical; a path ending in X is rejected by number_of before this comparison.
